title: Add project summary/overview command
description:
Add 'pebbles summary' or 'pebbles status' command showing project health at a glance:

Example output:
  Project Overview
  ════════════════
  Total issues: 12
  
  By Status:
    TODO: 10 (83%)
    IN_PROGRESS: 1 (8%)
    BLOCKED: 1 (8%)
    DONE: 0 (0%)
  
  By Type:
    Usecases: 8
    UX Problems: 2
    Design: 1
    Epics: 1
  
  Epics: 1 total
    Feature Development (3 issues, 0 done)
  
  Ready to work on: 3 issues (use 'pebbles next' to see)

Benefits:
- Quick project health check
- Understand scope and progress
- Find bottlenecks (many blocked issues)
- Entry point for navigation

Useful for standup updates and project status.
